title: Digest trigger failures are printed but do not fail the test
reasoning: The isolated pytest path claims to test the pipeline through digest generation, but a non-200 response from /digests/trigger only prints the error and then the function continues to print 'Basic tests passed!'. This allows a broken digest trigger to pass CI.
reproduction: Make /digests/trigger return any non-200 response; scripts/test_flow.py::test_with_testclient will still complete without an assertion failure.
recommendation: Assert that the trigger response is successful and validate the response shape, at minimum r.status_code == 200 and an id field. If full pipeline coverage is intended, also poll/verify output as the live-server path does.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The existing test explicitly accepts the failure branch without raising or asserting, so it cannot catch the broken behavior.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add an assertion that the /digests/trigger response status is 200 and that the response JSON contains a non-empty id.
minimumFixScope: Change the non-200 branch in test_with_testclient to fail the test instead of only printing.
